headline: India and Poland Agree to Double Bilateral Trade Volume by 2030
summary: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk agreed to double bilateral trade by 2030 and establish a joint Defence Industry Dialogue for military co-production.
why: Expanding commercial and defense ties between India and Central European economies provides trade diversification and defense manufacturing opportunities.

impacts.name: Defense & Manufacturing
impacts.why: Bilateral co-production agreements support domestic manufacturing output and technology sharing.
